edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded to the ISakeSwapCallee callback and emitted in the Swap event.
mint() compares msg.sender with the factory migrator to select the initial liquidity path.
burn() emits msg.sender as the Burn event sender.
transferFrom() debits allowance[from][msg.sender] unless it is type(uint).max.
initialize() requires msg.sender == factory before binding tokens.
setFeeTo() requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter() requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setMigrator() requires msg.sender == feeToSetter.
onlyOwner modifier requires _owner == msg.sender for slippage token mint/burn.
block.timestamp is reduced to uint32 and used to compute timeElapsed for the price accumulators.
block.timestamp determines the elapsed/remaining portion of the virtual price decay window.
permit() requires deadline >= block.timestamp before accepting a signature.
local blockTimestamp is derived from block.timestamp inside _update.
_update writes reserve0 = uint112(balance0).
_update writes reserve1 = uint112(balance1).
_update stores blockTimestampLast for the next elapsed-time computation.
price0CumulativeLast is accumulated with unchecked addition where overflow is intended.
price1CumulativeLast is accumulated with unchecked addition where overflow is intended.
virtualPrice is recomputed as a time-weighted average of stored and current price using SafeMath.
lastPriceTime is advanced to the current block timestamp after recomputation.
mint() reads totalSupply as _totalSupply to derive LP liquidity.
mint() increases balanceOf through _mint and reads balances for the amount computation.
mint() sets kLast = uint(reserve0).mul(reserve1) after a fee-on liquidity event.
mint() calls _mintFee before computing the newly minted liquidity.
mint() calls _update with post-deposit balances.
mint() reads the factory migrator address to gate the migrator-only initial mint.
mint() queries ISakeSwapFactory(factory).migrator().
burn() calls _mintFee before computing pro-rata withdrawals.
burn() calls _update after re-reading balances.
burn() sends both underlying tokens out via _safeTransfer.
burn() reads the pair's own balanceOf and burns it.
swap() optimistically transfers output tokens via _safeTransfer.
_safeTransfer performs the low-level token.call with the ERC20 transfer selector.
swap() invokes ISakeSwapCallee(to).SakeSwapCall when calldata data is non-empty.
The SakeSwapCall callback executes before balances are reconciled, permitting re-entry into swap state logic.
_mintFee reads factory feeTo to decide whether protocol fees are minted.
_mintFee uses and resets kLast within the sqrt(k) growth computation.
_mintFee derives fee liquidity from totalSupply and sqrt(k) growth.
initialize() assigns the token0 state variable.
initialize() assigns the token1 state variable.
initialize() deploys SakeSwapSlippageToken(0) and stores it as stoken.
initialize() requires msg.sender == factory read from storage.
permit() recovers the signer from the EIP-712 digest via ecrecover.
permit() writes allowance through _approve once the signature matches owner.
permit() increments nonces[owner] to invalidate replay of the signature.
ecrecover output is stored in local recoveredAddress and compared against owner.
transferFrom() reduces the spender allowance using SafeMath.sub.
createPair() deploys the pair bytecode through inline assembly create2.
createPair() calls initialize(token0, token1) on the freshly deployed pair.
dealSlippageWithIn() mints slippage tokens through stoken.mint when ifmint is true.
dealSlippageWithOut() mints slippage tokens through stoken.mint when ifmint is true.
skim() moves balances above reserves out via _safeTransfer.
sync() forces reserves to match balances by calling _update.
swap() reads reserve0 for liquidity bounds and the K invariant.
swap() reads and later rewrites reserve1 through _update.
swap() calls _updateVirtualPrice before _update.
swap() uses balance.mul(1000).sub(amountIn.mul(3)) SafeMath arithmetic for the K check.
mint() relies on SafeMath sub/mul/div for balance deltas and liquidity math.
burn() relies on SafeMath mul/div for pro-rata amount computation.
getAmountInFinal() adds 1 to the integer division result and blends market/real values with SafeMath.
getAmountOutFinal() subtracts the arbitrager half-slippage and computes stoken amounts with SafeMath.
swap() indirectly consumes block.timestamp through the virtual price update and reserve timestamp.
mint() reads the stored reserve0 via getReserves for the liquidity formula.
mint() reads the stored reserve1 via getReserves for the liquidity formula.
_updateVirtualPrice() performs weighted-average division and SafeMath sub of the decay period.

normalization_plan.reason: swap() recipient parameter `to` is the sink of the optimistic token transfers and callback target.
swap() amount0Out directly drives the _safeTransfer of token0 and the reserve bounds check.
swap() amount1Out directly drives the _safeTransfer of token1 and the reserve bounds check.
swap() calldata `data` is the trigger condition for the external SakeSwapCall callback.
permit() spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping via _approve.
permit() value parameter becomes the approved allowance amount.
transferFrom() from parameter is the account whose allowance and balance are debited.
permit() owner parameter must equal the recovered signer address.
permit() deadline parameter is compared against block.timestamp.
initialize() _token0 parameter is stored into the token0 state variable.
initialize() _token1 parameter is stored into the token1 state variable.
createPair() tokenA parameter participates in the pair key, sorting and create2 salt.
createPair() tokenB parameter participates in the pair key, sorting and create2 salt.
dealSlippageWithIn() path parameter selects the in/out reserve ordering and token checks.
dealSlippageWithIn() amountIn parameter feeds getAmountOutReal and the deposited-balance requirement.
dealSlippageWithIn() to parameter receives the minted slippage tokens.
dealSlippageWithIn() ifmint flag controls whether stoken.mint executes.
Local blockTimestamp derivation is absorbed into the reserve and cumulative price update logic.
Local timeElapsed is absorbed into the cumulative price accumulator computation.
Local balance0 in mint() is absorbed into the amount0/liquidity computation.
Local amount0In in swap() is absorbed into the input-amount checks and K invariant.
Local liquidity in mint() is absorbed into LP token minting and the >0 requirement.
Local currentPrice in _updateVirtualPrice() is absorbed into the virtual price update.
Local recoveredAddress in permit() is absorbed into the ecrecover validation against owner.
